title: Starting on bass with the Golden Rule Band, c. 1918-19
summary: Asked when he learned, Eddie says he started a year before his father died in 1919 and joined the Golden Rule Band around 1918-19.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
